comments.body:
@kompfner I see the `LLMThoughtEndFrame` definition includes the ability to set the thought signature. I'm assuming this is acceptable.

I can see that the signature is always None, at least for now. I'm not sure if/when that will change. The Gemini Live API has been changing a lot and I expect that it will continue to.
